## Create

| Code                  | What it does   |
| --------------------- | -------------- |
| `xs = [1, 2, 3]`      | A list literal |
| `xs = list(range(5))` | From a range   |

## Modify

| Code                 | What it does         |
| -------------------- | -------------------- |
| `xs.append(4)`       | Add to the end       |
| `a if x \| y else b` | Escaped pipe in code |
